heroSummary: Aurora Public Schools begins the 2025-26 student calendar on Thursday, August 14, 2025, after new-student orientation for grades 6-12 on August 13. The last student day is Thursday, May 28, 2026. The official calendar lists 176 student days, Thanksgiving and winter closures, a March spring break, and separate teacher and professional days.
calendarNotes: The source PDF is titled Aurora City School District School Calendar 2025-2026 and separates student attendance dates from staff preparation and records days. New Teacher Orientation is August 8, the teacher professional day is August 11, and the opening staff meeting is August 12. The first semester runs through December 19 with 86 student days; the second semester runs January 5 through May 28 with 90 student days.

customSections.label: How to Read the APS Calendar
customSections.content: The APS source calendar distinguishes family-facing breaks from days reserved for staff work. Those categories matter for childcare, transportation, meal access, and school-office availability.

rows: Student closure windows such as Thanksgiving, winter, and spring breaks.
No School for Students / Teacher Work Day
Students do not attend; staff may be scheduled for professional, records, or planning work.
The August 13 orientation is listed for grades 6-12 before the all-student opening.
A staff records day follows each major term boundary and is not a student attendance day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Aurora Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for all students on the 2025-26 APS calendar is Thursday, August 14, 2025. Grades 6-12 have new-student orientation on August 13.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the APS 2025-26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar identifies 176 student days: 86 in the first semester and 90 in the second.

calendarFaqs.q: When is winter break for Aurora Public Schools in 2025-26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026. January 5 is a teachers record day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of APS school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 28, 2026, followed by a teachers records day on May 29.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families verify APS calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the APS calendars page and the current district PDF for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Aurora Public Schools.
